canonical_location.role: runtime authority for Research Harness long_history(); a zip of this directory is only a portable delivery / backup mirror

runtime_rule: The routine Harness LONG path consumes these frozen series as-is. F1 is never refit and S3 is never rebuilt at runtime. provenance/proxy_construction_AUDIT_ONLY/ is kept for audit only and is never imported or executed by the Harness. No production module, production state or execution path may depend on this kit.
purpose: Frozen input series of the 2026-10-04 26Y long-history study, packaged so the Research Harness LONG surface (long_history_universe.py) can consume them without rebuilding proxy plumbing. Not production data; no production module reads this kit.

TLT.identity: PROXY for the long-Treasury role (Vanguard Long-Term Treasury mutual fund); NOT TLT

GLD.identity: PROXY for the gold role (gold + silver trust); NOT GLD; contains silver exposure

BTAL.source_series: BTAL long proxy (F1 or S3, caller must choose) chain-linked into real BTAL
BTAL.identity: PROXY before 2011-10; real BTAL from 2011-10 onward (first full month of real BTAL)

F1.definition: rf + a + 0.7176*BAB - 0.6165*(Mkt-RF) before 2011-10; real BTAL from 2011-10 (chain-linked, kit convention)

S3.definition: rf + mean_{ME3,ME4,ME5}(LoBeta - HiBeta), French size x beta, EW cells, before 2011-10; real BTAL from 2011-10

MF.identity: managed-futures CATEGORY PROXY; NOT a DBMF reconstruction; the LONG vehicle of the Structural MF sleeve (PROD vehicle DBMF, MEDIUM substitute AQMIX)

structural_mf_sleeve_ontology.sleeve: Structural MF (economic sleeve / structural capital seat of the US sleeve)
structural_mf_sleeve_ontology.sleeve_weight: 15% of the US sleeve — sleeve-level architecture constant, not a DBMF weight

vehicles.LONG: AQR TSMOM (this kit; long-history category proxy)

structural_mf_sleeve_ontology.evidence_rule: AQMIX / AQR TSMOM evidence is never DBMF production-equivalent evidence
structural_mf_sleeve_ontology.governance: changing the vehicle does not change the sleeve architecture; a production vehicle replacement still requires formal production governance

btal_variant_rule: F1 and S3 are BOTH primary. No default, no averaging, no winner. They differ only in the BTAL leg before the 2011-10 splice: two proxy constructions, not two independent historical universes.

not_canonical_and_not_exposed.HYBRID / MIX2: descriptive midpoint only in the 26Y study; file not included
not_canonical_and_not_exposed.BAB (lab kit btal_extended.csv): negative control / legacy proxy only; file not included
not_canonical_and_not_exposed.other columns of data/derived/btal_proxy: the loader reads only the BTAL (real) column, for the splice identity check

price_and_tsmom_source.repo_head_at_26Y_study: 09a9a866 (per the 26Y artifact README); file hashes identical to the 26Y input_identity.json

provenance.hash_agreement: every data/ file hash equals the corresponding sha256 in provenance/input_identity_26Y.json (prices, TSMOM, F1, S3); copies are byte-for-byte
provenance.not_done: no refit of F1, no new coefficients, no reconstruction of S3, no newly downloaded series, no interpolation or backfill

payload_identity_rule: sha256 over the lines '<path>  <sha256>' of all class=data files, sorted by path, joined by \n
